description: The placeable speaker rows (default empty) — the camera family's audio sibling (see WorldSpeaker): name-keyed transducers whose feeds tap shared sources.

items.description: One placeable speaker in the world — the camera family's sibling: abstract, name-keyed, $type-discriminated, whole-row UpsertSpeaker/RemoveSpeaker. Routing chiasmus: screens consume cameras; speakers consume audio sources. Omni-only v1 (no cones — stereo separation is already the feed model). A new speaker kind is a new derived record plus its JsonDerivedTypeAttribute line.

anyOf.description: A speaker posed directly in world space.

name.description: The speaker's stable name — its mutation address.

anyOf.description: A speaker anchored to a WorldAnchor — the entity/part/placement pose it rides supplies the live position; Offset is the exact attachment point in the anchor's local axes on top of that. Unlike cameras, speakers resolve every anchor kind, placements included (the placement's stamped transform is reachable client-side from the definition plus the animator state).

offset.description: The attachment point relative to the anchor's resolved pose, in anchor-local axes.

name.description: The speaker's stable name — its mutation address.

anyOf.description: An ambient bed — a region presence, not a position: center-panned, its gain an envelope of the listener's distance from Center — full inside InnerRadius, zero at Radius — with its presence slew bounded by FadeSeconds. Box extents become a later $type only if a sphere proves dishonest.

center.description: The region's extent center, world space.

radius.description: The region's outer radius — the envelope's zero and the cull edge.

innerRadius.description: The full-presence inner radius; 0 shoulders the envelope from the center.

fadeSeconds.description: The presence slew bound in seconds (null = the audio defaults' DefaultBedFadeSeconds).

name.description: The speaker's stable name — its mutation address.

attenuation.description: The point-attenuation policy, or null to coalesce to the WorldAudioDefaults section. Beds carry their own radii instead and leave this null.

radius.description: The finite audible support radius in world units — at or beyond it the emitter is culled (finite support is the cull).

curve.description: The falloff curve token (CurveSmoothstep or CurveLinear), or null for the audio-defaults curve.
